attributes.action: Solar Panels to be installed on all new and existing houses by the government
attributes.additional_details: As a collective we can make this happen but we need dedication and to hold the government accountable once and for all. The future generations are counting on us.
attributes.background: Action needs to be taken immediately preserve the nature we have left and prevent anymore damage from happening hence why we need to invest in renewable energy to make this beautiful earth green again. There is no other way.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/777148
